verdict.rationale: Honeybadger's hosted MCP server supports OAuth, so an agent gets its own credential through browser approval instead of a pasted credential. This counts as a first-party way to issue agent-specific credentials, but no evidence shows the grant can be scoped or limited to least privilege. missing for 10: documented scopes or permission levels for API/OAuth tokens, per-project or read-only restriction options, token management and revocation docs, independent corroboration.
